rationale: The idea has a credible signal.
Run a focused validation experiment before building.

evidence.claim: Mock evidence for the test path.

monetization.revenue_notes: Primary buyer: indie founders. Monetize the validation report around pain: uncertain idea demand.

signals: No novelty veto on this run

experiments.name: Mom Test interviews
experiments.success_metric: ≥5 indie founders describe uncertain idea demand in their own words without prompting the solution
experiments.hypothesis: indie founders currently feel uncertain idea demand at least weekly
experiments.method: Interview 5–8 indie founders; ask about last time the pain happened, workarounds, and willingness to pay — never pitch the idea first

experiments.name: Fake-door / smoke landing
experiments.success_metric: ≥5% CTR to waitlist or ≥10 qualified signups
experiments.hypothesis: indie founders will click/sign up for a solution to uncertain idea demand
experiments.method: One landing page + CTA; drive a small paid or community traffic burst; no full product

experiments.name: Riskiest Assumption Test
experiments.success_metric: Riskiest assumption falsified or supported with ≥1 concrete evidence artifact
experiments.hypothesis: Users will pay for validation report within 14 days of a credible promise
experiments.method: Write the single riskiest assumption, design the cheapest test ≤$100 / ≤2 weeks, run it, record evidence grade

lean.unfair_advantage: Founder-market fit signal present — deepen it

jtbd.job: When I am evaluating a new product idea, I want to address uncertain idea demand
jtbd.outcome: So I can move forward with validation report confidently

weaknesses: Evidence mostly L0/L1 until experiments run
threats: Incumbents can copy a thin wedge quickly

pestle.political: Export controls and AI policy can change model access/cost; keep vendor flexibility.
pestle.economic: Willingness 68/100 — price probes must stay cheap; verdict test implies minimize burn until evidence.
pestle.social: indie founders adopt tools via communities and peer proof; trust > hype for uncertain idea demand.
pestle.legal: Respect user data, scraped evidence licenses, and marketplace ToS if integrating third-party APIs.
pestle.environmental: Model inference has energy cost — prefer smaller models / caching for validation loops.
